body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-20 02:46Z, learned the hard way). Every landing moves master, so EVERY gate frozen on the previous master stops counting for landing, including a gate that is RUNNING at the moment of the landing (a landing commit needs parent = current master and tree = gated tree). Tonight: the P0 landing (a5cca6e7) invalidated the credited Darwin and w-604b gates on 476c45c7; then the S4b landing (on a5cca6e7) invalidated the w-604b gate that had just launched on a5cca6e7. Practice: (1) Before giving a gate GO, check whether another item is about to land (evaluation passed, landing package in flight); if so, either land that first and carry before the gate, or hold its landing until the running gate's item lands too. (2) Prefer landing order = gate order: gate, evaluate, land, then broadcast the new master, then carry, then the next gate. (3) Never kill a running gate to recover; let it finish as evidence. Related: w-edd8fa00da6b (batch-gate credit) would remove most of this cost.
